cues.en: Instructor: If your data look nothing remotely similar to a normal distribution, if they don't even approach a Gaussian distribution,
cues.zh: 講師：如果資料完全不像常態分布，甚至連接近高斯分布都談不上，

cues.en: then you can use what's called the modified zed score method for identifying outliers in your data set.
cues.zh: 就可以使用所謂的修正 Z 分數方法，辨識資料集中的離群值。

cues.en: So here you see an example of a strongly non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡是嚴重偏離高斯分布的例子。

cues.en: This looks nothing like a bell curve.
cues.zh: 完全不像鐘形曲線。

cues.en: This is a non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 這是非高斯分布。

cues.en: So we're gonna use the modified zed score for detecting, you know, this point is probably an outlier over here.
cues.zh: 所以要使用修正 Z 分數偵測，例如這裡這個點可能就是離群值。

cues.en: Okay, so fortunately it's really simple to use this method.
cues.zh: 幸好，這個方法非常簡單。

cues.en: It's in fact basically the same as the algorithms that I showed you in the previous video.
cues.zh: 其實基本上和前一部影片的演算法相同。

cues.en: So you convert the data to a modified zed score, and I'll explain what that is on the next slide, and then you just test which data points are above some threshold, and you can use the same threshold,
cues.zh: 把資料轉換成修正 Z 分數，下一張投影片會解釋那是什麼，再檢查哪些資料點超過某個門檻；可以使用相同門檻，

cues.en: let's say three, for example.
cues.zh: 例如 3。

cues.en: And then any data point that has a modified zed score of greater than three is identified as an outlier and removed.
cues.zh: 任何修正 Z 分數大於 3 的資料點，都被辨識為離群值並移除。

cues.en: You can also use the iterative method that I explained in the previous video as well.
cues.zh: 也可以使用前一部影片解釋的迭代方法。

cues.en: Okay, so the only difference is we replaced the regular zed score with the modified zed score.
cues.zh: 所以唯一差別，就是把一般 Z 分數換成修正 Z 分數。

cues.en: Here is the modified zed score.
cues.zh: 這就是修正 Z 分數。

cues.en: It is based on medians instead of means.
cues.zh: 它以中位數為基礎，而不是平均值。

cues.en: But otherwise, the modified zed score is pretty similar to the regular zed score.
cues.zh: 除此之外，修正 Z 分數和一般 Z 分數相當類似。

cues.en: So remember with the regular zed score, we subtract the mean and divide by the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 記住，一般 Z 分數是減去平均值，再除以標準差。

cues.en: And here we take each data point and we subtract the median of the data.
cues.zh: 這裡則是從每個資料點減去資料的中位數。

cues.en: So we're not subtracting the mean, we subtract the median of the data.
cues.zh: 所以不是減平均值，而是減中位數。

cues.en: I'm using this X with a tilda on top to indicate the median.
cues.zh: 我用上方加上波浪號的 X 表示中位數。

cues.en: It's not really standard widely used notation, but it's what I'm using here.
cues.zh: 這不算是廣泛使用的標準記號，但這裡就這樣用。

cues.en: And then that's divided not by the standard deviation, but by something that's called the median absolute deviation.
cues.zh: 接著不是除以標準差，而是除以稱為中位數絕對偏差的量。

cues.en: I'm sorry I didn't write that down anywhere on this slide, but it's median absolute deviation.
cues.zh: 抱歉，投影片上沒有寫出全名，但它叫做中位數絕對偏差。

cues.en: That's what it stands for.
cues.zh: 縮寫代表的就是這個。

cues.en: And here is the formula for the median absolute deviation.
cues.zh: 這裡是中位數絕對偏差的公式。

cues.en: What you do is you take all of the individual data points and you subtract the median, and then you take the absolute values of that set of numbers,
cues.zh: 從所有個別資料點減去中位數，再對這組數字取絕對值，

cues.en: and then you take the median of that set of numbers.
cues.zh: 接著取這組數字的中位數。

cues.en: If you remember back to the video on variants, I actually introduced another metric that's pretty similar to this.
cues.zh: 如果記得介紹變異數的影片，我其實介紹過另一個相當類似的量值。

cues.en: That one was called the mean absolute difference.
cues.zh: 那個稱為平均絕對差。

cues.en: And there it was a pretty similar formula.
cues.zh: 公式相當類似。

cues.en: So we took the absolute value of each data point minus the mean, and then we took the average of all of those points.
cues.zh: 從每個資料點減去平均值，取絕對值，再對所有這些點取平均。

cues.en: So what we're doing here is taking all of the individual data points minus the median, taking the absolute value of those differences.
cues.zh: 這裡則是從所有個別資料點減去中位數，再取差值的絕對值。

cues.en: And then we take the median of those absolute deviations from the median.
cues.zh: 接著對這些相對於中位數的絕對偏差，取中位數。

cues.en: That is called the median absolute deviation.
cues.zh: 這就叫做中位數絕對偏差。

cues.en: Okay, so we take each data point and subtract the median, divide by the kind of median version of the standard deviation, and then we have to multiply by this weird looking number.
cues.zh: 好，從每個資料點減去中位數，再除以某種中位數版本的標準差，然後必須乘上這個看起來奇怪的數字。

cues.en: It is a, kind of a bizarre factor to include in here.
cues.zh: 在這裡加入這個因子，確實有點古怪。

cues.en: But it turns out that this is just the, this value turns out to be the standard deviation units corresponding to the 75th percentile,
cues.zh: 但這個數值，其實是第 75 百分位數所對應的標準差單位，

cues.en: or the third quartile, of the standard normal or the standard Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是標準常態分布，或標準高斯分布的第三四分位數。

cues.en: So that's just a normalization factor to make the modified zed scores be more similar to the regular zed scores.
cues.zh: 所以它只是個正規化因子，讓修正 Z 分數更接近一般 Z 分數。

cues.en: Okay, and again, once you've computed this modified zed score, you apply exactly the same procedures that I outlined in the previous video.
cues.zh: 同樣地，算出修正 Z 分數後，就套用前一部影片概述過的完全相同程序。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Now you know how to identify outliers using the zed score method for a Gaussian distribution that's in the previous video, or a strongly non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 現在你知道，如何對前一部影片的高斯分布，以及嚴重偏離高斯分布的資料，使用 Z 分數方法辨識離群值。

cues.en: And that's what you learned in this video.
cues.zh: 後者就是這部影片學到的內容。
